programs.title: Ocean Warriors
programs.desc: An anxious 'Mayday' from a vessel with a missing diver sends Kitkatla's Coast Guard Auxiliary racing to Captain's Cove.

programs.title: A Cedar Is Life
programs.desc: An intimate look at the relationship and importance of the cedar tree to the cultural life of West Coast First Nations through interviews by artists, elders and practitioners who discuss the importance of all parts of the tree.

programs.title: Stand By Me
programs.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from `The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

programs.title: Countryman
programs.desc: Two friends attempt to trace the broken song lines of their forefathers triggering an unexpected chain of events.

programs.title: The Secrets Of Pecan Summer
programs.desc: We reveal the true story behind the first Indigenous Opera. Composed by Deborah Cheetham, Pecan Summer is her discovery of what really happened to her family in 1939 and why she never knew the truth.

programs.title: Unsettled
programs.desc: The Keetch family decides to stay with Molly indefinitely due to recently unfolded unfortunate events; Darryl and Rayna search for new jobs; Myles enrolls in the local high school on the reservation.
